site.name: Hank’s Workbench
hero.brand.problem: Expertise is hard to explain and content lacks a clear theme
hero.brand.method: Define the audience and positioning, then turn real cases into content
hero.brand.result: A positioning page, topic library, and first script
hero.brand.feedback: Use audience response and inquiries to refine the positioning
hero.leader.problem: The leader and team disagree on what to do first
hero.leader.method: Set the goal, select a pilot, and define ownership and acceptance criteria
hero.leader.result: A priority map and an AI workflow ready to test
hero.leader.feedback: Use pilot results to decide what to fund next
hero.product.problem: An idea exists, but the use case is still untested
hero.product.method: Interview users, identify the core task, and build a testable prototype
hero.product.result: Ranked requirements, clickable prototype, and test plan
hero.product.feedback: Use observed behavior to adjust scope
hero.channel.problem: Content goes out across platforms, but lead sources are unclear
hero.channel.method: Define channel roles and map reach, capture, and follow-up
hero.channel.result: A channel map, publishing cadence, and lead tracker
hero.channel.feedback: Reallocate effort based on lead quality
hero.delivery.problem: Handoffs and acceptance criteria vary across projects
hero.delivery.method: Map order to acceptance, with owners and human escalation points
hero.delivery.result: A delivery workflow, acceptance checklist, and exception log
hero.delivery.feedback: Use rework and delays to locate bottlenecks
hero.org.problem: Critical know-how lives with a few people
hero.org.method: Clarify roles and decision rights, then define how the team shares knowledge
hero.org.result: A roles map, team cadence, and knowledge base structure
hero.org.feedback: Use handoff problems to identify remaining gaps
hero.data.problem: Reports disagree and meetings get stuck on definitions
hero.data.method: Start from the decision and align metric definitions, sources, and owners
hero.data.result: A metric dictionary, source inventory, and dashboard prototype
hero.data.feedback: Trace gaps and anomalies back to their sources
hero.capital.problem: Limited resources make competing investments hard to compare
hero.capital.method: Document cash-flow assumptions and compare scenarios, costs, and risks
hero.capital.result: An allocation comparison and a list of assumptions to test
hero.capital.feedback: Revisit the assumptions using actual cash flow
